craft_notes: Sthāyin: dappled-sky gaze (eyes as instrument, light as target). Rows: row 3 (fixed→shines). Close: shines (#2 in four — the block's light-refrain). Rejected: 'watch' — killed: gaze fixed kept (dṛṣṭi niveśya as technical act); 'aura' — killed: self-form kept.

lines: gaze fixed right there — own self-form shines.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tejasā sūryadīpāder ākāśe śabalīkṛte | dṛṣṭir niveśyā tatraiva svātmarūpam prakāśate

reads_against.argmap: Where is gaze fixed? → Fixed in the dappled sky, own self-form shines forth.
c1_essence: Dappled sky gaze fixed: own self-form shines.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness at the edge of intensity)
